summary: Federal Forest Service stairway tower in Cass County, erected after 1935; the county survey says it was sold and removed in the 1972 tower sale.

facts.status_note: The county survey says it was sold and removed in the 1972 tower sale; the Forest Fire Lookout Association lists it as gone.

events.note: The survey says only 'erected after 1935'. 1935 is a lower bound, not a known build year.
Sold and removed in the 1972 tower sale. The survey says 'It too' was sold, as other Chippewa National Forest towers were.

notes_for_editor: Only one detailed source: a Wikimedia Commons PDF county tower survey. It gives no build year and no survey date, so the story is short by necessity. The Forest Fire Lookout Association agrees the tower is gone, and the brief's coordinates (47.01097, -94.36841) match the survey's 47.0109 and -94.3683. No source describes the site today. Access is unknown and is left out. No corrections to the brief. Lead if more time: Chippewa National Forest or Cass County newspaper coverage of the 1972 tower sale, and any photo of the structure.
